_about: How each researched item is shown to donors. Research facts (numbers, sources, quotes) stay in data/research/. This file only adds wording, measures, and whether an entry is a charity or a general program type. Donor notes are one plain sentence: no first person, no numbers, no technical errors.

health.explainer: A DALY is one year of healthy life. Lower cost per DALY means more health for each dollar.
health.caveat: Estimates come from different evaluators and years, and some are old, so treat small differences between charities as noise.

poverty.explainer: Dollars of extra income or spending for poor households for each dollar given. Higher is better.
poverty.caveat: Some figures are reported by the charities themselves, and they count benefits in different ways. GiveDirectly is the benchmark program itself.

education.explainer: A learning-adjusted year is one extra year of school counted by how much children actually learn. Lower cost per year is better.
education.caveat: Education studies measure results in different ways, so charities are only ranked against others that use the same measure.

climate.explainer: One tonne of carbon dioxide kept out of the air. Lower cost per tonne is better.
climate.caveat: These are rough estimates for policy work, which their authors say to compare only by order of magnitude. The benchmark is the estimated harm of a tonne of carbon dioxide, not another charity.

measures.usd_benefit: dollars of extra income or spending
measures.school_years_equiv: equivalent years of schooling, estimated from test scores

deworm_the_world.program_note: Evidence Action's Deworm the World Initiative runs this kind of program. The estimate is for deworming in general, not for one charity.

conditional_cash_transfers.donor_note: The research reviewed gives a general judgement but no number, so this program type can't be ranked.

helen_keller_intl_vas.donor_note: Published estimates count lives saved rather than healthy years gained, so this charity can't be put on the same scale yet.

new_incentives.donor_note: Published estimates count lives saved rather than healthy years gained, so this charity can't be put on the same scale yet.

health:deworm_the_world.donor_note: No current estimate of healthy years gained per dollar has been published for this charity.

brac_ultra_poor_graduation.donor_note: Published estimates disagree widely depending on how long the benefits are assumed to last, so no single number is shown.
